en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, simple Baroque-style manor or small castle with a long, steeply pitched tiled roof and regularly spaced windows. The building is partly obscured by large trees in front, with a central entrance approached through a landscaped garden and two white lion statues flanking the path. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the title identifying the place.
